stories.title: Flintshire Council writes to Transport for Wales over ‘Tap and Go’ rail fare signage
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s chief executive has written to Transport for Wales asking for new signage at stations on the Wrexham to Bidston line, after Tap and Go ticket machines were found to charge full adult fares regardless of age or Railcard status. stories.title: New maternity safety scheme rolled out across Wales
stories.summary: A new scheme giving families a direct route to raise urgent concerns about a mother or baby’s deteriorating health is being rolled out in hospitals across Wales, but the minister responsible could not say when it would be running consistently everywhere. stories.title: Council tax and cuts alone will not close Flintshire’s £22m budget gap, cabinet hears
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council cannot currently rule out issuing a Section 114 notice, cabinet has been told, as it faces a budget gap of up to £22 million for 2027-28.
